title: 两个独立的群并行运算
Independent operations in parallel
text: 直积 G×H 的元素是有序对，运算逐坐标进行。单位元是 (e,e)，逆元是 (g⁻¹,h⁻¹)。
The direct product has ordered pairs as elements and coordinatewise multiplication. Its identity is (e,e) and its inverses are coordinatewise.
example: ℤ₄×ℤ₆ 的元素 ([a],[b]) 每一步分别在两个圆周上前进。两边同时回到原点才完成一个周期。
In ℤ₄×ℤ₆, each coordinate moves around its own cycle. Both must return simultaneously.

title: 直积中元素的阶
Orders in a direct product
text: 若 g、h 都为有限阶，则有此公式；任意一个坐标无穷阶时，(g,h) 也无穷阶。
For finite-order coordinates, the pair has order equal to their least common multiple. If either coordinate has infinite order, so does the pair.
proof: (g,h)ᵏ=(gᵏ,hᵏ)，所以它等于单位元当且仅当两个坐标都回到单位元。
(g,h)ᵏ=(gᵏ,hᵏ), so both coordinates must be identities.
有限阶时，条件是 |g|∣k 且 |h|∣k，最小正解为最小公倍数；无穷阶坐标则不存在这样的 k。
For finite orders, k must be a multiple of both orders. Infinite-order coordinates never return for positive k.

title: 两个循环群的直积何时循环
When a product of cyclic groups is cyclic
text: 对正整数 m,n，直积为循环群当且仅当两个阶互素。关键比较是元素可能达到的最大阶与群的总阶。
For positive m,n, the product is cyclic exactly when the orders are coprime. Compare the largest possible element order with mn.
proof: 若 gcd(m,n)=1，两个生成元组成的元素阶为 lcm(m,n)=mn，因此生成全群。
If m and n are coprime, a pair of generators has order mn and generates the whole product.
若 gcd(m,n)>1，任意元素的阶都整除 lcm(m,n)<mn，所以没有生成元。
If they are not coprime, every element order divides lcm(m,n)<mn, so no element generates the product.

title: 内部直积分解
Internal direct products
entries.tex: G=HK,\ H,K\trianglelefteq G,\ H\cap K=\{e\}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad G\cong H\times K
text: 若两个正规子群交平凡且乘积覆盖 G，则每个元素都能唯一写成 hk，且两个因子互相交换。
If two normal subgroups intersect trivially and their product covers G, every element has a unique expression hk and the factors commute.
proof: 对 h∈H,k∈K，交换子 hkh⁻¹k⁻¹ 因 H、K 都正规而同时属于 H、K，故等于 e。
The commutator hkh⁻¹k⁻¹ belongs to both H and K by normality; trivial intersection forces it to be e.
定义 H×K→G，(h,k)↦hk。因两个因子交换，映射保乘法；G=HK 保证满射。
The map (h,k)↦hk preserves multiplication because the factors commute, and is onto by G=HK.
若 hk=e，则 h=k⁻¹∈H∩K，所以 h=k=e，核平凡，映射是同构。
If hk=e, h=k⁻¹ belongs to the intersection. Thus both are identities and the map is injective.
warning: 仅有 H∩K={e} 且 G=HK 不够：D₃=⟨r⟩⟨s⟩，但 D₃ 不是 C₃×C₂。
Trivial intersection and G=HK alone do not suffice: D₃=⟨r⟩⟨s⟩ is not C₃×C₂.

title: 从群论看中国剩余定理
The Chinese remainder map
entries.tex: \mathbb Z/mn\mathbb Z\longrightarrow\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z\times\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z,\quad[x]\mapsto([x],[x])
text: 当 m,n 互素时，这个自然映射是加法群同构。一个整数的模 mn 信息，可以由模 m 与模 n 的两份信息共同确定。
For coprime m,n, the natural residue map is an isomorphism of additive groups. The two residues together determine the residue modulo mn.
proof: 模 mn 相等蕴含模 m、模 n 分别相等，所以映射良定义且保加法。
Congruence modulo mn implies congruence modulo m and n; the map is well-defined and additive.
若 x 同时被 m,n 整除，由互素性得 mn∣x，因此核平凡。
If both m and n divide x, coprimality implies mn∣x, so the kernel is trivial.
源、目标都有 mn 个元素，有限集合上的单射于是为双射。
Both sets have mn elements, so this injection is a bijection.
example: 求 x≡2 mod 3，x≡3 mod 5：在模 15 下唯一解为 [8]。
The congruences x≡2 mod 3 and x≡3 mod 5 have the unique solution [8] modulo 15.

title: 直积分解唯一性与消去律
Uniqueness and cancellation
entries.tex: A\times B\cong A\times C\Longrightarrow B\cong C
text: 有限群的不可分解直积因子，其同构类型及重数唯一。因此有限群的直积满足消去律。下面证明 Krull–Remak–Schmidt 定理，并说明给定同构为何未必直接诱导剩余因子间的同构。

For finite groups, the isomorphism types and multiplicities of indecomposable direct factors are unique. This gives direct-product cancellation. We prove the Krull–Remak–Schmidt theorem and explain why a given isomorphism need not directly induce one between the remaining factors.
非平凡群 D 称为直积不可分解，如果 D 同构于 U×V 时，必有一个因子为平凡群。
A nontrivial group D is directly indecomposable if any decomposition D≅U×V has a trivial factor.
Krull–Remak–Schmidt 定理：每个非平凡有限群都能分解为有限个非平凡不可分解群的直积。若有以下两种分解，则因子数相同，重排后各因子逐一同构。唯一性指同构类型及重数，不是子群本身相等。

The Krull–Remak–Schmidt theorem: every nontrivial finite group is a product of nontrivial directly indecomposable groups. Two such decompositions have the same number of factors, which are pairwise isomorphic after reordering. Uniqueness concerns types and multiplicities, not equality of subgroups.
存在性：若一个因子可分解，就继续分解它；所得非平凡因子的阶数严格减小，故过程停止。以下四步证明唯一性。
Existence: keep decomposing any decomposable factor. The orders of the resulting nontrivial factors strictly decrease, so the process terminates. The following four steps prove uniqueness.

title: 02 · 正规自同态：与共轭相容
02 · Normal endomorphisms

text: 正规自同态是与所有共轭映射相容的群自同态。映射的幂表示反复复合；若某次迭代把全群送到单位元，则称该自同态幂零。
A normal endomorphism is a group endomorphism commuting with every conjugation map. Powers mean iteration. An endomorphism is nilpotent if an iterate sends the whole group to the identity.
直积的因子投影都正规：将像视为原群的子群，逐坐标验证。正规自同态的复合仍正规，正规自同构的逆也正规，因为它们都与共轭映射交换。

Factor projections are normal when their images are viewed as subgroups of the original group; check coordinatewise. Composites of normal endomorphisms and inverses of normal automorphisms remain normal, since they commute with conjugation.

title: 03 · 核与像分解：可逆或幂零
03 · Kernel and image: invertible or nilpotent

text: 设 H 有限，θ 为正规自同态。核的递增链稳定，故可取充分大的 m 满足下式，并记 K、L 为相应的核与像。
Let H be finite and θ normal. The increasing chain of kernels stabilizes. Choose m as below and denote the kernel and image by K and L.
交平凡：若 z=θᵐ(y) 属于 K，则 y 属于 θ²ᵐ 的核，也属于 θᵐ 的核，所以 z=1。
Trivial intersection: if z=θᵐ(y) is in K, then y is in the kernel of θ²ᵐ, hence in the kernel of θᵐ, and z=1.
互相交换：取 k∈K、ℓ=θᵐ(y)∈L。k 在核中给出 θᵐ(k)=1。第一处等号用 θᵐ 的正规性，第二处用同态保乘法，最后代入 θᵐ(k)=1。
Commutation: take k∈K and ℓ=θᵐ(y)∈L. Membership in the kernel gives θᵐ(k)=1. The first equality uses normality of θᵐ, the second uses its homomorphism law, and the last substitutes θᵐ(k)=1.
第一同构定理也称同态基本定理：同态的源群商掉核后，同构于像。这里应用于 θᵐ，得 H/K≅L，故 |K||L|=|H|，从而 H=K×L。若 H 非平凡且不可分解，K、L 必有一个平凡：K 平凡使 θ 单射，有限性使它可逆；L 平凡使 θ 幂零。

The first isomorphism theorem, also called the fundamental homomorphism theorem, identifies the domain modulo the kernel with the image. Apply it to θᵐ to get H/K≅L, hence |K||L|=|H| and H=K×L. If H is nontrivial and indecomposable, one factor is trivial. Trivial K makes θ injective and hence invertible by finiteness; trivial L makes θ nilpotent.

title: 04 · 从若干映射中选出一个自同构
04 · Select an automorphism

text: 引理：H 非平凡、有限且不可分解。设 θ₁,…,θₜ 都正规，各自的像两两交换，且以下等式对所有 x 成立，则至少一个 θⱼ 为自同构。
Lemma: let H be nontrivial, finite and indecomposable. Suppose θ₁,…,θₜ are normal, their images commute pairwise, and the following identity holds for every x. Then some θⱼ is an automorphism.
对 t 归纳。t=1 时显然。若 θ₁ 可逆则完成；否则上一引理给出 θ₁ 幂零。令 ψ 为其余映射逐点乘积；各像两两交换保证 ψ 是同态，而且正规。

Induct on t; the case t=1 is immediate. If θ₁ is invertible, we are done. Otherwise θ₁ is nilpotent. Define ψ as the pointwise product of the remaining maps. Pairwise commutation of the images makes ψ a homomorphism, and it is normal.
若 ψ(x)=1，原等式给出 x=θ₁(x)。迭代到 θ₁ 的幂零次数便得 x=1。因此 ψ 单射，由有限性为自同构。
If ψ(x)=1, the original identity gives x=θ₁(x). Iterating until θ₁ becomes trivial gives x=1. Thus ψ is injective and, by finiteness, an automorphism.
用 ψ 的逆复合其余映射，得到 t−1 个仍满足引理条件的正规自同态。归纳给出某个 ηⱼ 可逆，于是原来的 θⱼ 也可逆。
Compose the remaining maps with the inverse of ψ. The resulting t−1 normal endomorphisms still satisfy the hypotheses. Induction makes one ηⱼ invertible, and then the corresponding θⱼ is invertible.

title: 05 · 配对一个不可分解因子
05 · Match one indecomposable factor

text: 把两种分解经同构搬到同一个 G 中，视为内部直积。令 α、βⱼ 为相应投影，像视为 G 的子群。对 A₁ 中的 x，下面的正规自同态像两两交换，逐点乘积为恒等映射。

Transport the decompositions into the same G as internal direct products. Let α and βⱼ be factor projections with images viewed as subgroups of G. On A₁, the following normal endomorphisms have commuting images and their pointwise product is the identity.
由上一引理，重排后可设 θ₁ 可逆。令 f、g 为下面两个限制映射。gf 可逆使 f 单射。fg 是 B₁ 的正规自同态。
After reordering, θ₁ is invertible. Define the restrictions f and g below. Invertibility of gf makes f injective, and fg is a normal endomorphism of B₁.
对任意正整数 m，下面右端是非平凡单射，故 fg 的任何迭代都不可能是平凡同态。由可逆或幂零的二分法，fg 可逆。因此 f 也满射，完成一个因子的配对。

For every positive m, the right-hand side below is a nontrivial injection. Thus no iterate of fg is trivial. The invertible-or-nilpotent dichotomy makes fg invertible, so f is also surjective. This matches one factor.

title: 06 · 交换因子，再对商群归纳
06 · Exchange factors and induct on the quotient

text: 令 D 为其余 B 因子的乘积（s=1 时取平凡群）。β₁ 在 A₁ 上单射，而 D 是 β₁ 的核，所以 A₁ 与 D 交平凡。
Let D be the product of the remaining B factors, trivial when s=1. Since β₁ is injective on A₁ and D is its kernel, A₁ intersects D trivially.
A₁、D 都正规，故混合交换子落在交集中，两个子群互相交换。再用已经证明的 A₁≅B₁ 比较阶数，得到 G=A₁×D。
Both A₁ and D are normal, so mixed commutators lie in their intersection and the subgroups commute. Comparing orders using A₁≅B₁ gives G=A₁×D.
将 A₁ 商掉，剩余两种直积分解出现在同一个更小的商群中。对 |G| 归纳，平凡群只有空分解；商群的阶严格减小，故剩余因子可逐一配对。再加上 A₁≅B₁，就证明了全部因子的唯一性。这里并未预先使用消去律。

Quotient by A₁. The remaining decompositions belong to the same smaller quotient. Induct on |G|, with the trivial group having the empty decomposition. The quotient has smaller order, so the remaining factors match. Together with A₁≅B₁ this proves uniqueness, without assuming cancellation.

title: 07 · 推论：有限群直积的消去律
07 · Corollary: cancellation for finite groups

text: A、B、C 都为有限群时，以下消去律成立。把三个群分解为不可分解因子；对每种同构类型 T，记它在三个分解中的重数为 a、b、c。
If A, B and C are finite, cancellation holds. Decompose all three into indecomposable factors. For each type T, write a, b and c for its multiplicities in the three decompositions.
blocks.tex: \begin{gathered}A\times B\cong A\times C\Longrightarrow B\cong C,\\a_T+b_T=a_T+c_T\Longrightarrow b_T=c_T.\end{gathered}

text: 唯一性使两边的重数相等，整数消去后得到 B、C 的因子逐一同构。选取各因子的同构，再逐坐标取直积，就得到具体同构。
Uniqueness equates the multiplicities. Canceling the integers matches the factors of B and C. Choose their isomorphisms and take the coordinatewise product to obtain an isomorphism.

title: 08 · 为什么给定同构未必直接诱导 B≅C
08 · Why restriction and projection can fail

text: 给定同构 φ，下面的限制再投影确实是同态，但未必为同构。例如 A=B=C=C₂，用加法记号，交换坐标的同构使它成为零同态。

Given an isomorphism φ, restriction followed by projection is a homomorphism, but may fail to be an isomorphism. For A=B=C=C₂ in additive notation, swapping coordinates makes it the zero homomorphism.
若额外知道 φ 把指定的 A 因子映到目标中指定的 A 因子，才可直接通过商群诱导同构。分解唯一性的证明则先通过投影找到可逆的配对，再交换因子。

If φ sends the specified A factor onto the specified A factor in the target, it induces an isomorphism of quotients directly. The uniqueness proof instead finds an invertible pairing using projections and then exchanges factors.
允许 A 无限后，消去律一般不成立，即使 B、C 有限。A 的元素是只有有限个非零项的二元序列，运算逐项相加。
Allowing infinite A destroys cancellation in general, even with finite B and C. Elements of A are binary sequences with finite support, with coordinatewise addition.
下面两个映射互为逆，保持逐项加法；移动有限个坐标保持有限支撑。因此 A×B≅A×C，但 B、C 的阶分别为 2、4，不能同构。
The following maps are inverse and preserve coordinatewise addition. Moving finitely many coordinates preserves finite support. Thus A×B≅A×C, but B and C have orders 2 and 4 and are not isomorphic.

question: ℤ₄×ℤ₆ 中 ([1],[1]) 的阶是多少？
What is the order of ([1],[1]) in ℤ₄×ℤ₆?
reason: It is lcm(4,6)=12, not the product.

question: 哪个群同构于 C₁₂？
Which group is isomorphic to C₁₂?
reason: 3 与 4 互素，C₃×C₄ 是 12 阶循环群。
The coprime orders 3 and 4 give a cyclic product of order 12.

question: 内部直积分解中，哪组条件充分？
Which conditions suffice for an internal direct product?
options: H,K 正规、交平凡且 G=HK
reason: 两个正规子群的交换子落在交集中，故因子交换；其余条件给出双射。
Normality puts mixed commutators in the intersection; the remaining conditions give a bijection.

question: x≡1 mod 3，x≡2 mod 4 的模 12 解是？
Solve x≡1 mod 3, x≡2 mod 4 modulo 12.
reason: 10≡1 mod 3 且 10≡2 mod 4；互素性保证模 12 唯一。
10 satisfies both; coprimality ensures uniqueness modulo 12.

question: 证明：若 G×H 循环，则 G、H 都循环。
Prove that if G×H is cyclic, then both factors are cyclic.
reason: 设 G×H=⟨(g,h)⟩。投影到第一坐标得到 G=⟨g⟩，投影到第二坐标得到 H=⟨h⟩。逆命题还需要额外条件。
Project a generator (g,h) to each coordinate: every element of G is a power of g, and likewise for H. The converse needs additional hypotheses.
